services.description: Broad maintenance of the property. Assessed through its observable components (PRD §63); the client profile decides which components are required.

evidence_types.description: Plant beds look tidy: defined, mulched or cleared, no overgrowth.
Plant beds look neglected: overgrowth, weeds, spilled debris.
The scene looks generally well kept.
Landscaping equipment or crew visible.

safety_notes: An aesthetically pleasing landscape is not proof that any specific service occurred.
Assess each required component separately using visible evidence.

services.description: Application of fertilizer to lawn or beds. Very hard to verify visually; defaults to human review (PRD §61).

evidence_types.description: Fertilizer granules or prills clearly visible on the soil or turf.
A lawn-treatment notification flag or sign is visible.
Grass looks green and healthy.
Spreader, sprayer, or other equipment visible.

safety_notes: Healthy or green grass does NOT prove fertilization.
Equipment in the image does NOT prove fertilizer was applied.

services.description: Crisp boundaries between turf and hardscape or beds.

evidence_types.description: Clean, straight boundary between grass and pavement or bed.
Freshly cut edge line or trench visible.
Grass spilling over curbs, walkways, or bed borders.
Edger or crew visible.

safety_notes: Equipment in the image does NOT prove edging was completed.

services.description: Evidence that grass/lawn areas were mowed.

evidence_types.description: Lawn appears evenly short and recently cut.
Visible mowing stripes or pattern.
A section of lawn appears unmowed.
Grass appears tall or overgrown.
Grass clippings left on walkways or pavement.
Mower or crew visible.

safety_notes: Equipment in the image does NOT prove mowing was completed.

services.description: Removal of weeds from beds, turf, or hardscape cracks.

evidence_types.description: The area in view shows no visible weeds.
Pulled weeds collected in a pile, bag, or tarp.
Fewer weeds than expected, but some remain.
Weeds clearly visible in the serviced area.
Crew or tools visible.

safety_notes: 'Weeds reduced' is not the same as 'weed removal completed' (PRD §62).
A maintained-looking area is not proof that weeds were removed.

evidence_types.description: Fresh pruning cuts visible on branches.
Canopy raised or thinned with clearance over walkways, roofs, or signs.
Branches overhanging or obstructing where trimming was expected.
Cut branches collected on site.
Saws, lifts, or crew visible.

safety_notes: Equipment or cut branches alone do NOT prove the required trees were trimmed.

services.description: Removal of litter, debris, and leaves.

evidence_types.description: The area in view is free of litter, debris, and leaf build-up.
Debris or leaves bagged or piled for removal.
Trash or litter visible in the serviced area.
Significant leaf accumulation remaining.
Blowers or crew visible.

safety_notes: Bagged debris shows collection began, not that the area was cleared.

services.description: Shaping and pruning of shrubs and hedges.

evidence_types.description: Shrubs or hedges have a freshly shaped, uniform profile.
Fresh cut surfaces visible on shrubs.
Shrubs appear overgrown or unshaped.
Shrub clippings on the ground.
Trimmers or crew visible.

safety_notes: Clippings or equipment alone do NOT prove the required shrubs were pruned.

services.description: Service addressing dead or brown grass. The exact business requirement is unconfirmed (unknown U7), so it defaults to human review.

evidence_types.description: Previously dead area visibly treated, re-seeded, or re-sodded.
Dead/brown area appears unchanged.
Dead or brown grass is visible.

safety_notes: 'Dead/brown grass observed' is a different question from 'dead/brown grass service addressed' (PRD §64).
